mentions.heading: New product introduction depends on various factors
mentions.detail: Complex products; advanced nodes such as first 3nm PCIe Gen 6 Switch; AI-driven market changes
mentions.quote: Because our products are complex, we have experienced delays from time to time in completing new product development. New products may not receive or maintain substantial market acceptance.

mentions.heading: Ability to develop and implement new process technologies
mentions.detail: Transitions to advanced process technologies have caused reduced yields and delivery delays
mentions.quote: We and others in the industry have, from time to time, experienced difficulties in transitioning to advanced process technologies and have suffered reduced manufacturing yields or delays in product deliveries.

mentions.heading: Our operating results will suffer if we ineffectively utilize our manufacturing capacity or fail to maintain manufacturing yields.
mentions.detail: Unabsorbed capacity charges of $200.8 million in fiscal 2026 and $173.0 million in fiscal 2025
mentions.quote: In fiscal 2026 and in fiscal 2025, we operated at below normal capacity levels resulting in unabsorbed capacity charges of $200.8 million and $173.0 million, respectively.

mentions.heading: Our operating results are impacted by seasonality and wide fluctuations of supply and demand in the industry.
mentions.detail: Downturns in fiscal 2024-2025; backlog push-outs/cancellations; paused Fab 4 and Fab 5 expansion, reduced capex through fiscal 2027
mentions.quote: Consistent with the slowing macroeconomic environment during such periods, and the related inventory growth, we paused our factory expansion actions at Fab 4 and Fab 5 and reduced our planned capital investments through fiscal 2027.

mentions.heading: Our business is dependent on distributors to service our end customers.
mentions.detail: Distributors about 47% of fiscal 2026 net sales; no long-term agreements except LTSAs; termination with little notice
mentions.quote: Sales to distributors accounted for approximately 47% of our net sales in fiscal 2026 and approximately 45% of our net sales in fiscal 2025.
